title: Cairo to Kepler
note: The Book of Optics from Cairo to Kepler, one printed link at a time.

beats.text: This book took 600 years to cross Europe
It starts in Cairo, Egypt, about 1020
beats.sub: Ibn al-Haytham writes the Book of Optics

beats.callsub: the book is written, in Arabic
Europe translates it and calls him Alhazen

beats.text: Then it is copied and taught

beats.callsub: a scholar rewrites the whole thing
a printer prints both books as one

beats.text: And that printed book reaches Kepler
Every step here is on paper
beats.sub: you can look each book up by name

beats.text: None of this chain is guessed
